content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I’ve reviewed the draft and would like to suggest a small amendment before signing:

- The agreement currently states that all listed works created with content provided by PACIFICAP ENTERTAINMENT are wholly owned by THE HENRY FILM AND ENTERTAINMENT CORPORATION. This would transfer ownership to the client before any payment is received, which could leave the contractor without compensation for the intellectual property. I propose that the relevant clause be changed so that those works remain the property of the Contractor until full payment of all amounts due under the agreement.

Thank you for considering these changes. I look forward to finalizing the contract.

Best regards
